If you’ve been looking for the Jeff Cavaliere diet plan or wondering how to eat like ATHLEAN-X, this is a look at the foods behind my daily eating plan. I’ll explain what I eat, why I choose it, and how these foods fit into a muscle building diet that supports hard training while keeping calories under control.
Getting lean takes more than finding the right foods. Your total calories, protein intake, workouts, and consistency all matter. But choosing meals that satisfy your appetite and taste good makes it easier to stick with your nutrition plan long enough to see results.
